ngaap.guidance: 2019 guidance (affirmed/updated Apr-25-2019): GAAP sales ~$8.4bn; GAAP income from operations ~$800m; GAAP diluted EPS $2.40-$2.60 (GAAP net income $425-460m); EBITDA ~$1.3bn. Adjusted: sales ~$8.4bn, adjusted EBITDA ~$1.6bn, adjusted income from operations ~$1.2bn, adjusted EPS $4.00-$4.20 (adjusted NI $710-740m); adjusted operating margin ~14%; ETR ~24%; net synergy benefit ~$20m; GAAP CFO $500-600m incl. ~$300m merger expenses. Q2 adjusted EPS expected lower (fully diluted shares ~193m). Pro forma full-year GE Transportation: adjusted sales ~$9.2bn, adjusted EBITDA ~$1.7bn, adjusted op income ~$1.3bn. Synergy target $250m by year four.
ngaap.notes: 2019 'adjusted' definition (as originally reported): excludes GE Transportation merger costs - transaction & restructuring (and, from Q3, litigation) costs, one-time non-cash purchase price accounting (inventory step-up) charges, non-cash accounting policy harmonization, related merger financing interest and tax on non-deductible transaction costs. Recurring PPA amortization was NOT added back in 2019. EBITDA (2019 definition) = income from operations + depreciation + amortization (other income excluded, so ebitda_other=null); ebitda_dda = depreciation + amortization columns summed. From Q1-20 Wabtec redefined adjusted results (adds back all non-cash intangible amortization and FX losses; drops policy harmonization and one-time PPA in adjusted sales/GP) and EBITDA (= op income + other income + D&A). Recast in Q1-20 release under 2020 definition: adjusted op income 233.4, adjusted EPS $1.21 (adds back $27.4m amortization and $12.7m FX loss; no policy harmonization). Recurring PPA charges of $20m pre-tax ($0.12/sh) were not added back as originally reported.
